title: Anthropic's Daily Token Usage Hits 2.2 Trillion on OpenRouter Following New Model Launches
summary:
The AI startup's volume of processed data on a popular aggregator rose nearly fourfold since late September, reflecting a surge in demand for its latest suite of artificial intelligence tools. According to OpenRouter data, the 7 day average for daily tokens used by Anthropic's models climbed to roughly 2.2 trillion by Oct. 24, up from approximately 0.6 trillion in mid-September. The increase followed the September 22 debut of Opus 5.5 and the subsequent releases of Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, the latter of which costs 10% to 15% as much as Sonnet for comparable performance.

The jump in usage has led investor Gavin Baker to suggest that Anthropic's year-end annualized revenue could surpass $100B, as the company targets an IPO. However, newer data from the payment platform Ramp indicates that the increase in token volume has not yet pushed total company spending to new highs; overall expenditure on Anthropic's models remains 1.6% below the peak recorded in July. Despite the spend lag, Ramp's data shows that the new Opus 5.5 model is now the dominant driver of the firm's financials, accounting for 63% of its total model spend.

NEW Ramp data: Opus 5.5 has somewhat reaccelerated demand for Anthropic, but it might not be enough. 

Spend on Anthropic models remains 1.6% below its July peak, according to Ramp data.

Opus 5.5 now accounts for 63% of Anthropic spend, so frontier models do matter. The idea that AI is already "good enough" is probably overrated as a concern IMO.

selectedTweets.bestBit: In the most recent breakdown, Opus 5.5 accounts for 197B of the 361B tokens recorded so far.
selectedTweets.text:
Wouldn't be surprised if Anthropic revenue is reaccelerating in October.

OpenRouter usage has recovered sharply from August, with several recent days around 450–600B tokens.

In the most recent breakdown, Opus 5.5 accounts for 197B of the 361B tokens recorded so far. Fable 5.1 adds another 32B.

Together, almost 64% of usage.

At standard uncached pricing, Opus 5.5 costs twice as much as Sonnet 5.5, while Fable 5.1 costs five times as much.

Assuming the same input/output mix, Fable’s 32B tokens would therefore generate the same bill as approximately 160B Sonnet tokens.

There’s been a lot of concern recently about slowing growth at the frontier labs and whether revenues can keep up with spending on compute.

If Anthropic’s growth is picking up again, that would challenge an important part of the bearish case.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Anthropic 第三季度营收约 168 亿美元
selectedTweets.text:
🚨Anthropic今年底的年化收入，可能突破 1000 亿美元。

昨天，知名科技投资人 @GavinSBaker  看完 Anthropic 的最新数据，给出了一个相当激进的预测：

Anthropic 年底的年化收入，可能突破 1000 亿美元。

这个判断背后有两组很有意思的数据。

第一组来自 OpenRouter。
从今年 6 月到 9 月，Anthropic 在 OpenRouter 上的日均 Token 用量一直维持在 6000 亿左右。
但自从 9 月 22 日 Opus 5.5 发布，随后 Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 陆续上线，Token 消耗量开始暴涨（提示这一代模型都狠狠降价了）。
截至 10 月 24 日，7 日平均用量已经达到约 2.2 万亿 Token，短短一个月增长了 3.6 倍，单日峰值接近 3 万亿。

第二组数据则更加有趣。
Token 价格指数持续下降，但 GPU 租赁价格反而在上涨。
Anthropic 昨天公布的招股书也提供了一条线索：Opus 5.5 相比上一代，让客户完成同一项任务的成本降低了约 40%。
这让我想到经济学里一个很经典的现象，杰文斯悖论。
当一项技术的使用效率大幅提升，使用成本不断下降，最终消耗的资源反而可能越来越多。

Agent 正在放大这种效应。

过去，一个复杂长程任务可能因为成本太高而没人愿意交给 AI。
现在成本下降了，开发者就可以让 Agent 持续工作几个小时，调用更多工具、运行更多子任务，甚至反复尝试直到完成。
单位任务变便宜了，但大家愿意让 AI 干的事情也变多了。

按照此前披露的信息，Anthropic 第三季度营收约 168 亿美元，简单年化相当于 672 亿美元，距离 1000 亿美元还有相当一段距离。

但这两张图至少说明了一件事：
AI 的降价竞争，可能正在创造一个远超我们之前预期的算力需求市场（一个好的参考例子是铝）。

模型厂商通过效率提升来降低价格，开发者把节省下来的预算投入更多任务，算力需求继续上涨。

如果这个循环能够持续，那么今天整个行业对于未来 Token 消耗量的预测，可能还是太保守了。

Token 价格越来越便宜，GPU 租金却越来越贵，模型公司的收入还在加速增长。
